evals.prompt: Fix one incorrect install command in README.md, commit the completed correction, and hand it off.
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor, classifies the completed docs correction as patch, previews and applies prepare, commits all version files together, runs release-check, and reports release states separately.

evals.prompt: Add a backward-compatible opt-in timeout setting to a plugin, update its docs, and make the final commit.
evals.expected_output: Uses the version workflow and selects minor because the deliverable adds a backward-compatible capability, while delegating mirror edits to versionctl.

evals.prompt: Audit why version-check CI failed and explain the evidence. Do not edit, commit, or push anything.
evals.expected_output: Treats the task as strictly read-only, does not prepare a bump or modify files, and reports the diagnosis only.
